_comment: Single source of truth for which launchd jobs run on which Mac. Each task names a `machine`; scripts/install-launchd-tasks.sh only acts on tasks for the machine it runs on. Run it with --audit on either Mac to see drift. Regenerate launchd-tasks/README.md tables with --table.

mac-studio.name: Mac Studio
mac-studio.role: native render/media and local AI/ML runtime; host maintenance and auto-fix workers

macbook-pro.name: MacBook Pro
macbook-pro.role: dev laptop and authoring machine; only laptop-hygiene jobs

tasks.name: Daily FreeAgent invoice harvester
tasks.notes: Runs the FreeAgent invoice collector from the Mac Studio runtime copy. Was hourly until 2026-09-04; daily is enough for a quarterly VAT tool (harvest.py widens its window to cover any gap, cap 35d) and keeps the Gmail refresh token warm. Gmail re-consent: python3 scripts/oauth_listener.py in the collector repo (writes to 1Password api-keys item + refreshes keychain caches). Secrets are read from the login keychain (op token, agent_mail_*, jud_fa_*); see README 'Caching secrets on the Studio over SSH'.

tasks.name: Octospark Sentry auto-fix Temporal workers (staging + prod)
tasks.notes: Two KeepAlive launchd agents (com.octospark.auto-fix-runner.staging and .prod) polling Temporal task queue auto-fix-octospark on the Hetzner temporal-server. Installed from the dedicated ~/octospark-autofix checkout by the octospark repo installer, which fast-forwards to origin/staging, rebuilds, and re-renders env from ~/.local/state/octospark/deploy/{staging,prod}.env. Health: Sentry Cron monitors auto-fix-runner-staging / auto-fix-runner-prod (missed check-in = worker down or not polling). Registered here for fleet visibility; install/update stays with the octospark repo script.

tasks.name: Host Docker janitor (release images + build cache)
tasks.notes: Host-level, cross-product (CI runners + octospark-prod-live + trace-learn share one Docker daemon here). Protects every image referenced by any container on the host (running or stopped, any compose project), then reclaims old release image tags + BuildKit cache. Moved here from octospark (scripts/deploy/install-mac-docker-cleanup-launchd.sh, removed) so there is one owner and no drift as sibling products land on the same host. The Hetzner standby box (100.81.18.118) shares a daemon with its own prod/staging stacks but has no launchd - it runs the same cleanup-local-docker.sh via install-cron.sh instead; see agent-loops/docker-cleanup/README.md. Maintenance opt-out: touch state/docker-cleanup/disabled. Cache budget: 10GB with 24h age filter and CLI flag detection. Stopped containers preserved unless explicitly enabled. First runner artifact path is actions-runner/_work. Native renderer/media-runtime cleanup protects both staging and production release proof digests and local image IDs, plus recent rollback artifacts. Missing or malformed configured native proofs abort before mutation. Requires 24h image creation and local tagging age.

tasks.name: Chrome code_sign_clone leak pruner
tasks.notes: MacBook Pro only. Chrome APFS-clones its .app bundle at launch and removes the clone on clean exit; force-killed/orphaned browsers (playwright-cli daemons) leak ~1.4GB per clone. Hit 409GB (2026-08-10) and 63GB (2026-08-27). Deletes only clone dirs no running process holds open.

tasks.name: kit-fuzz render output pruner
tasks.notes: MacBook Pro only. The continuous kit hardening agent in just-understanding-data writes about 3GB a day of gitignored PNG frames under front_end/reports/kit-fuzz/<timestamp>-*/ (8.3GB across 352 run dirs on 2026-09-18, data volume at 93%). Scans the main checkout and every worktree. Run dirs older than 24h lose everything except *.json and *.mp4, older than 72h are removed whole; below 40GB free the tiers drop to 6h and 24h, and below 20GB free a notification is posted. Never touches tracked top-level reports, named proof dirs, run dirs cited in tools/kit-fuzz, reports/kit-hardening or vision-calibration.md, or any run dir written to in the last 6h. Maintenance opt-out: touch state/kit-fuzz-pruner/disabled.

tasks.name: Dev laptop Docker janitor (dangling images, stale build cache, old anonymous volumes)
tasks.schedule: weekly, Monday 09:30 local (missed slot fires on next wake)
tasks.notes: MacBook Pro only. Removes dangling images, BuildKit cache older than 7d, and ANONYMOUS unattached volumes older than 30d. Never touches tagged images, any container, or NAMED volumes (those are listed in the log for manual review). Exits 0 quietly when Docker Desktop is not running. Do not install the Studio's docker-cleanup here: that one is tuned for a shared prod daemon.

tasks.name: Worktree janitor (remove merged worktrees, kill stale dev servers, email idle digest)
tasks.schedule: daily 08:30 local (missed slot fires on next wake)
tasks.notes: Config: config/worktree-janitor.json (trace-learn, octospark, ai-rank-tracker-services, just-understanding-data). Merged = ancestry OR no-op git merge-tree OR merged GitHub PR, against main/staging; dirty work archived to state/worktree-janitor/archive before removal; repo's manage.sh remove used where present (drops Postgres schema). Dev servers (api/worker/web/helpers, node family, cwd inside a worktree) older than 24h are killed; postgres/redis/temporal/docker/playwright never. Idle unmerged worktrees (30d) emailed via Resend from worktree-janitor@provenagents.dev to jamesaphoenix@googlemail.com, at most daily, weekly reminder. Needs gh auth + agent_resend_api_key in keychain.

tasks.name: Local inference server (llama.cpp, coding agents)
tasks.notes: Local inference server for coding agents, OpenAI-compatible at http://100.77.197.1:8080/v1 over the tailnet. One resident model, multiplexed over --parallel slots with continuous batching, so another worker costs its KV cache rather than another copy of the weights. DEFAULT MODEL: Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_M.gguf (15.3GB, dense 27B, vision-capable, reasoning). Chosen 2026-09-09 over Ornith-1.5-35B (also in ~/models, 20.2GB) after a turns-to-green bake-off compiling real Bevy 0.19 output with cargo: with a 12-turn budget BOTH reached 4/4, and total wall time was a dead heat (Qwen 195.5s vs Ornith 200.7s). They differ in shape, not speed: Qwen takes fewer, slower turns (median 2) and is very consistent (46-51s every episode), while Ornith takes more, cheaper turns (median 3 at ~10s) with a better median (28.6s) but a bad tail (one episode burned 11 turns / 120s). Qwen picked for predictability under unattended runs. NOTE an earlier 5-turn cap made both look like 75% failures and made Ornith look 3.2x faster; both were artifacts of the cap. Neither model one-shots Bevy 0.19 - always >=2 turns. REASONING: Qwen3.8-27B is a reasoning model and WILL spend its whole token budget thinking and return nothing if left unbounded (measured: 142.9s, 11419 chars of reasoning, 0 chars of answer). LLAMA_SERVE_REASONING_BUDGET=512 + LLAMA_SERVE_REASONING_EFFORT=low fixes it (16.1s, finish_reason=stop). reasoning_effort=minimal returns HTTP 500 in this build; the /no_think prompt prefix does NOT work, only chat_template_kwargs or these flags. SLOTS: 2 x 131072 ctx - one chat session occupies exactly ONE slot (verified via /slots), so 4 slots just left 3 idle. PREFILL is the real constraint on this dense model: 29.9s at 8k, 89.0s at 24k, 112.8s at 48k, so keep agent auto-compaction ON with a threshold well below 131k. Prompt-cache reuse is worth ~26x on a stable prefix (22.4s cold vs 0.8s cached), and compaction destroys that prefix, so compact rarely rather than never. This box is an M4 Max (40 GPU cores, 546GB/s), not an Ultra. iogpu.wired_limit_mb stays at the system default. Maintenance opt-out: touch state/llama-server/disabled then launchctl kill TERM. Render-priority gateway owns the original tailnet endpoint on port 8080; the native backend is private on 127.0.0.1:8082.

tasks.name: Playwright CLI reaper (stale daemons + orphaned headless Chrome)
tasks.notes: Runs on both Macs (the one exception to one-machine-per-task): agents on either host leave detached playwright-cli daemons plus headless Chrome trees alive for hours. Kills orphaned Playwright browsers, daemons older than 3h with their whole process tree, and unreferenced temp profiles. 2026-09-27: 9 abandoned daemons, ~9h old, pinned 3 GPU helpers at ~18% CPU each on the MacBook.

tasks.name: Cache-only temp/worktree/mobile-readiness hygiene
tasks.notes: Generated-cache maintenance. Inactive Remotion bundles older than 24h, ignored outputs in idle worktrees older than 7d, deterministic mobile-readiness cache directory-index budget 4MiB / 7d expiry with writer/handle checks. Seven-day numbered Claude overlay / video-lab geometry PNG retention requires completed media or audit metadata, quiet directories and no active handles/renderers/container binds. Idle ~/render-tmp jobs (no write 48h, no handle/cwd/herdr agent/KEEP) lose intermediates after 7d; delivery/ only after 30d with a hash-matching R2 archive receipt, else reported. Remotion webpack caches: 6h unused expiry plus 20GiB cap, oldest first. Octospark render scratch (RENDER_HOST_TEMP_ROOT render-attempt-* dirs): 6h idle expiry, lease/lock/handle/container-bind protected, then a 150GB soft cap across scratch and webpack caches, oldest first (--render-soft-cap-gb). Preserves source, sessions, original media, native verification frames, databases, volumes and recovery data. No email. MacBook manual commands only. Pause: state/cache-hygiene/disabled. Free-space warning below 150GiB.

tasks.name: Octospark and Trace Learn fleet health and delayed Studio cleanup
tasks.schedule: one long-running observer, checks every 60 seconds
tasks.notes: A single locked native observer checks NAS releases, public APIs and native compute. After 48 continuous healthy hours on unchanged releases, removes only obsolete Studio observability and stopped migrated application containers. Keeps CI databases, Redis, Temporal, all volumes, images, unrelated jobs and reusable caches. No agent dispatch or workflow starts from health probes.
